description: Build, run and live-test FiveM servers with AI agents: RCON, DevCon, window control, mcpb bridge.
name: io.github.ziyacivan/fivem-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Machine running the FiveM client (DevCon host). Default 127.0.0.1
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_HOST

environmentVariables.description: FXServer game host:port for RCON/getinfo. Default <FIVEM_HOST>:30120
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_RCON_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: Matches rcon_password in server.cfg; required for server_command and the bridge
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_RCON_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Path to FXServer's redirected stdout (server.log); enables server-side console reads and bridge client results
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_SERVER_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Matches mcpb_token on the server when the bridge resource is configured with one
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_MCPB_TOKEN

title: FiveM MCP
